map.💡 LDO：效率=Vout/Vin，功耗=(Vin−Vout)×I；DCDC：输: 💡 LDO: efficiency = Vout/Vin, dissipation = (Vin−Vout)×I; DCDC: input power = output power ÷ efficiency, dissipation = input power − output power
